author: 鉄屑 カノン

en.title: The Rusted Star Chart and the Edge of a Rotten Sky
en.premise: In an era where the soot-choked sky hides even the stars, I make my living as a scavenger, picking through mountains of junk for parts to survive. One day, deep in the ruins, I find a strange antenna shaped like a 'broken sword' and an electronic chip engraved with an old 'star chart.' They are the relics of a foolish, beautiful plan from when humanity once tried to flee to the stars. To connect this scrap of junk to the other side of the sky, I set out on a journey, burning through my life and supplies.

zh.title: 锈蚀星图与腐朽天空的尽头
zh.premise: 在一个天空被煤烟笼罩、连星星也看不见的时代，我靠着当废品商，每日在垃圾山里搜寻勉强度日的零件。某天，我在废墟底层发现了一个仿造“断剑”形状的奇特天线，以及刻有古老“星图”的电子芯片。那是人类曾试图逃往星空、既愚蠢又美丽的计划遗物。为了将这堆破烂连通到天空的另一端，我燃烧着生命与物资，踏上了旅程。
